messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Deployment failure detected for service `ingest-api` in prod. Canary region returning repeated 500s. Paging on-call. link: https://infra.redwood/status/1948001234

alex: I'm on it — looking at canary logs now. Anyone touching KMS keys or envs in the last 24h?

priya: I deployed the canary at 12:07 to pick up `enable_embedding_v2` flag. Not touching KMS directly. Seeing lots of `AccessDeniedException` from the runtime when trying to decrypt model keys.

maria: FYI, ops rotated a customer-managed KMS key yesterday (rotation-job-2026-03-14). Confirming whether the service role was re-granted decrypt on the new key alias.

alex: Paste of error from logs:
```
ERROR ingest-api: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/ingest-prod-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```

jon: That lines up. If the role lost `kms:Decrypt` on the rotated key, the model artifact fetch will fail and return 500. Canary percentage spiking to ~18% errors.

alex: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Kill the feature flag `enable_embedding_v2` to stop new canary traffic to the new code path. 2) Rollback canary deployment to previous revision if flag kill doesn't stabilize. 3) Grant kms:Decrypt to `ingest-prod-role` on the new key. Who can edit KMS IAM right now?

maria: I'm doing the KMS IAM change now. Applying policy: 
```
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/ingest-models --policy file://grant-decrypt-ingest.json
```
Policy includes `kms:Decrypt` for `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ingest-prod-role`. Patch applied, waiting for propagation.

devops-bot: Runbook linked: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kms-rotation-deploy-failures — follow step 3 for quick ACL restore.

alex: Killing flag: `LDClient.toggle('enable_embedding_v2', false)` -> done. Observability: routing back to fallback model.

priya: Rolling back canary now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/ingest-api -n prod --to-revision=119` (started). Noted PodRestartCount increasing while new pods pick up old image.

jon: After the flag kill and rollback, canary error rate dropped from ~18% -> 0.6% in 3 minutes. Latency normalized. Marking customer impact as limited but non-zero: 1.4k failed requests across 12 minutes, mostly on a few high-traffic tenants (acct ids: 789, 1023).

maria: KMS policy verified applied. Did a `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc` as `ingest-prod-role` and it succeeded. :white_check_mark:

alex: Restarting the remaining affected pods to pick up policy/env: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest-api -n prod` -> done.

devops-bot: Incident page created: https://infra.redwood/incidents/1948001234 — Sev2, start time 1948001234, status: mitigating.

sre-runbook-bot: Auto-triage: assign Sev2; please run RCA template and capture timeline.

priya: Customer-facing note drafted: short apology + mitigation + ETA for RCA next 48h. Sharing in #support to prepare any outbound comms.

alex: Post-mitigation checks: traffic steady, errors at baseline 0.1%. Canary remains rolled back. Will not re-enable `enable_embedding_v2` until we have a coordinated key-policy check.

jon: For follow-up: create infra ticket to add detection: alert on `AccessDeniedException` from KMS for our service role AND block canary rollout when KMS decrypt errors > 1% in first 5m.

maria: Also adding a pre-rotation checklist for ops: update service IAM bindings or add a key alias transitional policy for 72h after rotation.

alex: Handing off to night on-call @jon for monitoring. I'll be around for the first 30m of handover. Next steps captured in the incident page.

jon: Taking the handover. Will monitor metrics and Slack. If error resurfaces, escalate to oncall-sre.

sre-runbook-bot: Incident status changed to: mitigated. Please fill postmortem template when ticket created.

alex: Thanks everyone. Good catch on the rotated KMS key. We'll follow up with a short postmortem and a post-deploy checklist for any future key rotations. :lock:
